title: USPS Change of Address - basics
facts: USPS offers Change of Address service to forward eligible mail from an old address to a new address.
Submitting a USPS Change of Address does not automatically update an address with the IRS, Social Security, DMV, banks, insurers or other organizations.
Mail forwarding is temporary and different classes of mail have different forwarding periods and treatment.
Consumers should use official USPS channels and separately update important senders directly.
